Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Part IV, Section A, Line 3b: Description Of When and How Organization Made The Determination
Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: SUPPORTED ORGANIZATION, OLD MISSION ROTARY CLUB, IS A 501(c)(4) ORGANIZATION AFFILIATED WITH ROTARY INTERNATIONAL. AS SUCH IT HAS ALWAYS CONFORMED TO REQUIRED POLICIES AND BYLAWS.

Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Part IV, Section A, Line 3c: Explain What Controls The Organization Put In Place
Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: MEMBERS OF ART PRATT FOUNDATION BOARD ARE ALSO MEMBERS OF OLD MISSION ROTARY CLUB. COMMON MEMBERSHIP ENSURES FUNDS ARE USED IN COMPLIANCE WITH REGULATIONS.

Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Part IV, Section D, Line 3: Role The Organization's Supported Orgs. Played
Form990ScheduleAPartVIGrp.ExplanationTxt: MAJORITY OF THE FOUNDATION'S INVESTMENTS ARE MANAGED BY AN OUTSIDE FINANCIAL INSTITUTION. BOARD MEMBERS MEET WITH A REPRESENTATIVE OF THE FINANCIAL INSTITUTION AT LEAST ONCE ANNUALLY TO DISCUSS AND DETERMINE STRATEGY, DIRECTION AND GOALS IN ORDER TO BEST SUPPORT THE FOUNDATION'S MISSION.ANNUALLY BOARD MEMBERS DISCUSS AND AGREE ON A TARGET AMOUNT OF GRANTS TO BE DISTRIBUTED BASED ON PRIOR AND PROSPECTIVE INVESTMENT PERFORMANCE AND THE PLANNED COMMUNITY SERVICE ACTIVITIES OF THE OLD MISSION ROTARY CLUB.
